I will do this small maize plot the way I can manage with my own hands and little money. This plot is very small, and I do not want to spend cash on fertilizer or bought seed when I have not seen many women like me gain from that on such a small piece. I will use the manure I can gather at home, plant my usual seed, and weed it myself with family help when the rain comes.
